Questions Before You Order

Clear answers for common buyer concerns

Does SweepBot Pro work on tiled floors?

Yes. It is suitable for tiles and other hard floors commonly used in homes and offices.

Can it clean under beds and furniture?

Yes. The low-profile body helps it reach under many beds, sofas, tables, and cabinets.

How do I charge it?

Place it on the included charging dock after use. A full charge gives it enough power for daily cleaning.

Can I pay when it is delivered?

Payment on delivery is available in Accra after your order is confirmed. Orders outside Accra require advance payment before dispatch.

What if I have an issue after buying?

Your order includes a warranty, so you can contact us for support if the product develops an issue.
